why: PseudoDojo's stringent NC sets have been validated against a phonon database for 3d transition metals. Iron, in particular, is known for soft modes if the pseudopotential is too soft.
Lanthanide phonons are sensitive to 4f treatment; psl-high has the explicit 4f.
PseudoDojo's "stringent" NC sets have the multiple projectors that GW needs.
PAW with 3s/3p semicore; PSLibrary's spin-polarised variants handle the spin correctly.
psl-high's PAW has the semicore needed for the U correction.
